parameters.review_frequency: annual, first trading session of the calendar year
parameters.cost_model: B3 regular fee plus participation-dependent slippage, priced per ticker liquidity
parameters.tax_model: 15% on realised equity gains, 17.5% on the redeemed defensive sleeve

selection_rationale: Busca aninhada sobre 36 configuracoes no painel 2011-2025: para o ano t o ranking usa apenas anos ja encerrados, por Sharpe do excesso sobre o CDI, com troca cobrada como rebalanceamento integral. Configuracao viva para 2026: eq55_n5_triple_factor. A janela 2017-2025 ranqueou os candidatos e por isso nao pode testa-los.

evaluation.in_sample_status: Exploratory. The candidate grid, the factor family and the constraint set were all chosen while these years were visible. Reported historical figures describe the sample, not expected return.

success_criterion.falsification: Failure to clear the CDI after tax over the full prospective window, or a drawdown beyond the stated limit, refutes the rule. A single good year does not confirm it and a single bad year does not refute it.

amendment_policy: Any change to the rule, the parameters or the input files creates a new registration with a new date. The superseded registration is kept; it is not edited.
